mapper.sql: id, parent_id, name, code, path, component, icon, type, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM permission WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.name, p.code, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.type, p.sort_order, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.parent_id ASC, p.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.code IS NOT NULL AND p.code != ''

SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, p.name, p.code, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.type, p.sort_order, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.parent_id ASC, p.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC
